#!/bin/bash
# Check that DocsPageActions.astro excludes both /certs and /wiki from "View as Markdown" action
# This ensures the broken /wiki.md link is no longer generated

FILE="src/components/docs/DocsPageActions.astro"

# The fix should have a condition that excludes BOTH /certs AND /wiki
# Before the fix: only excluded /certs
# After the fix: excludes both /certs and /wiki

if grep -q 'currentPath !== "/certs".*currentPath !== "/wiki"' "$FILE" || \
   grep -q 'currentPath !== "/wiki".*currentPath !== "/certs"' "$FILE"; then
    echo "PASS: Both /certs and /wiki are excluded from markdown action"
    exit 0
else
    echo "FAIL: The condition does not exclude both /certs and /wiki"
    exit 1
fi
args.command: bash -c 'FILE="src/components/docs/DocsPageActions.astro"; if grep -q '"'"'currentPath !== "/certs".*currentPath !== "/wiki"'"'"' "$FILE" || grep -q '"'"'currentPath !== "/wiki".*currentPath !== "/certs"'"'"' "$FILE"; then echo "PASS: Both /certs and /wiki are excluded from markdown action"; exit 0; else echo "FAIL: The condition does not exclude both /certs and /wiki"; exit 1; fi'
args.requirement: The DocsPageActions component must exclude both /certs and /wiki paths from getting the "View as Markdown" action, preventing a broken /wiki.md link.
